integrity: The transition table is independently transcribed from the defining source. Exact exhaustive power-automaton BFS and shortest-path polynomial propagation prove the threshold, target, total and marginals. A separately represented set-based first-arrival computation reproduces every marginal coefficient, and the verifier expands the displayed factorizations by exact integer convolution.
scientific_limitations: The claim is finite and exact for the six-state five-letter Theorem 3 automaton. It does not assert the factorization for general \(n\). Originality is supported by targeted literature, database, alias, exact-number, and implication searches, not by an exhaustive proof of absence from all literature.
title: Exact shortest-reset letter marginals for the six-state five-letter slow automaton
